properties.description:
This detection should monitor when privileged accounts reset their password via SSPR, because if an attacker compromises an admin account and uses SSPR, it’s a high-severity persistence action.

The query you pasted (CLI spray detection) looks like a mix-up, so here’s the right SSPR query for privileged users (based on AuditLogs)
properties.query:
let queryperiod = 30d;
let queryfrequency = 1h;
let PrivilegeUsers = (
    IdentityInfo
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(queryperiod)
    | mv-expand AssignedRoles
    | where AssignedRoles matches regex 'Admin'
    | summarize by tolower(AccountUPN));
AuditLogs
| where TimeGenerated > ago(queryfrequency)
| where ResultDescription == "User started self-service password reset operation."
| extend AccountUPN = tolower(InitiatedBy.user.userPrincipalName)
| extend IPAdress = InitiatedBy.user.ipAddress
| where AccountUPN in (PrivilegeUsers)
